author: NASS
description:
Step into the forgotten streets of 1930s Chicago and witness everyday life during the Great Depression through this rare historical footage. From narrow alleyways and modest neighborhoods to children playing in the streets and hardworking families facing difficult times, this film offers an authentic glimpse into one of America's most challenging decades.

If you enjoy historical restorations like this, don't forget to Like, Comment, and Subscribe to support future projects.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive atmosphere
